current.text: He is not in Sacramento's projected starting five. The projected starters are Acuff, LaVine, Hunter, Murray and Sabonis.
Sacramento refused to play Malik Monk last season and could give his bench minutes to Clifford.
Lloyd rated his summer league as very mid for a player aged 24.5 and worries he will not make it in the NBA.

durable.text: He is an inefficient shooter. Kings passers had low assist conversion partly because he could not make shots.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Bench role, with Malik Monk competing for the same minutes; Sacramento may favor Clifford.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him 215 to 219, far outside the 144 players our auction drafts, so do not spend on him. His projected line (about 10 points on 44% FG) has no category above the top 250 pool. Steals, the closest, are only at pool level. Early in the season, check whether Sacramento gives him Monk's bench minutes and whether his shooting improves. Until then he is not worth a waiver claim.
